name: The Morning Rush
description: Regulars at the corner café each ordered a different drink and a different pastry one busy morning. Work out who had what.
clues: Felix goes with neither Tart nor Toffee.

Latte goes with at most one of Greta, Croissant, and Amber.
Mocha, Scone, Almond, and Rose belong to different orders.
Scone goes with exactly three of Cara, Mocha, Toffee, and Ivory.
Croissant goes with none of Felix, Macchiato, or Amber.
